name: mirage
text: The two BoltOdds sockets are on because they are not only for live: they also feed the fair odds of the normal pregame scan (and bids), read straight from memory, so they cost no API credits and make the fair odds fresher; that is why they stay open with Live off. Kalshi and SX Bet, the sockets that are live-only here, are correctly off. So it is not a live-engine cost, but the Live tab made it look like one. I'm adding a line under the socket list saying this (next release). If you want them closed anyway, Settings › APIs › Sockets › BoltOdds off; the pregame scan then falls back to BoltOdds' plain requests (about every 12 s), a little less fresh.
